notes: POWO accepts Justicia pilosella; Siphonoglossa pilosella is a homotypic synonym.

target_zone_range_leads.guardrail: Research-only. Deep Review must verify accepted taxonomy and exact target-zone native counties; no county inference.
leads: POWO lists the south-central U.S. to central Mexico and Texas as native.
Master Plant Pool has 15 personal wild observations and Hays Local status.
UT Williamson County provides a detailed local treatment; exact native threshold counties remain a Deep Review task.

morphology_candidate.look_here_first: Start with the plant's scale and hairs: it forms a very low decumbent mound with conspicuously ciliate leaf margins, then look for paired axillary pale pink-purple tubular flowers.
diagnostic_traits: suffrutescent perennial forming a low mound
small opposite elliptic leaves with rounded tips
club-shaped capsule with up to four seeds

confusers.separator: J. pilosella is low, dry-site and hairy; water-willow is aquatic, tall, glabrous, rhizomatous and long-leaved.
